notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two Doctors.
You have enough mana to cast Twice Upon a Time and the self-suspending card, if needed, during the first turn.
easyPrerequisites: You have a storm count of 1 if the self-suspending card is not in your hand, or a storm count of 0 otherwise.
description:
Cast the self-suspending card by paying its mana cost if its in your hand, or any other spell otherwise if you have not cast a spell this turn.
Cast Twice Upon a Time by paying its mana cost.
Taigam triggers, copying Twice Upon a Time and then exiling it with four time counters on it and giving it suspend.
Resolve the copy of Twice Upon a Time, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of that turn's upkeep, Twice Upon a Time and the self-suspending card's suspend abilities trigger, removing a time counter from each of them.
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing three time counters from Twice Upon a Time and the self-suspending card, triggering their suspend abilities.
Resolve the self-suspending card's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost, and eventually exile it with time counters on it.
Resolve the Twice Upon a Time's suspend trigger, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.name: Twice Upon a Time // Unlikely Meeting
